steps.caption: Open Buildings under Records, then Add building.
Type the building name.
Kind: a building, a tower inside a campus, a campus, or a project. Add the campus first, then each tower.
More details: parent campus, locality, address, grade, area, floors, completion and map pin.
Pick the locality, so searches and shortlists by place find it.
Press Create building.
The building page. The Building section lists its facts; blanks say unknown.
Spaces & availability is empty — nothing is assumed vacant. Add a floor.
Floor label is kept as text, like '5' or 'Upper Ground'. Unit is optional.
More details: carpet and chargeable area, and seats — add if known.
Press Add space.
Floor 5 appears with 'No availability evidence' — we haven't said it is free yet.
Now record availability: a dated snapshot.
Choose the floor and the date you heard it.
Status: available, under offer, leased, withdrawn — or unknown.
Evidence: 'claimed' if the landlord said so, 'verified' only if you checked it now.
More details: available-from, valid-until, and the asking rent.
Rent basis says which area the rent is quoted on — carpet, chargeable or per seat.
Press Save snapshot.
Floor 5: Available (reported), as of today, asking ₹85/sf on chargeable area.
Leases, specifications and other names are added the same way, further down.
